subject: english
question:
Rearrange the following sentences in correct order to make a meaningful sentence
P: while the committee deliberated on the proposed reforms, Q: numerous stakeholders voiced their concerns R: regarding the potential impacts S: during the public consultation process
solution:
The correct answer is** Option (3)** i.e. **QSRP**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence logically begins with **Q**, as it introduces the stakeholders voicing their concerns, which is central to the topic.
 
• Following **Q**, **S** provides the context for when these concerns were voiced, i.e., "during the public consultation process."
